description: This file implements DNS configuration management functions for a WAN manager, including setting DNS modes, adding/removing static DNS servers, and handling DNS forwarding rules.

methods.name: get_logical_iface_path
methods.description: Retrieves the logical interface path for a given interface object by extracting its name and constructing the path.

methods.name: remove_static_dnsservers
methods.description: Removes all static DNS forwarding rules by calling the DeleteForwarding method for each alias.

methods.name: set_forwarding
methods.description: Sets DNS forwarding rules for a given address object and interface, adding static DNS servers.

methods.name: add_static_dnsservers
methods.description: Adds static DNS servers for a specified interface object, cleaning up previous rules if necessary.

methods.name: set_dnsmode
methods.description: Configures the DNS mode (e.g., DNSMode, IPv6DNSMode) in the DNS relay configuration.

methods.name: dns_mode_set
methods.description: Main function to set DNS mode and configure static DNS servers for interfaces.

methods.name: dns_mode_unset
methods.description: Removes static DNS forwarding rules, effectively unsetting the DNS mode.
